Game Overview

At its heart, Santa VS Zomby is a christmas game about help Santa save Christmas by launching him at zombies to recover stolen gifts. Navigate physics-based fun as you knock down enemies and collect presents, ensuring smiles on every child's face. Family-friendly and packed with holiday cheer, it's the perfect game for some festive fun!
